_about: Your corrections to the Claude review. 'themes' are standing taste rules distilled from past corrections; the reviewer follows them. 'keep' / 'hide' hold individual stories (by id) to show or keep off the page, each with a note and the date it was added. A weekly job folds new notes into themes and removes story entries older than 14 days, after their stories have left the page. Add entries with: python3 tools/override.py keep|hide <id> "note"
